ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white patch located in the center-mid region of the left lobe. High-frequency white mottling and discrete spots distributed along the proximal edge near the peduncle and lower ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 70 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary; most pronounced on the distal edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed on the outer trailing edge sweep of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular spots (3-8 pixels in diameter) along the trailing edge and within the lower-left fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-on-dark vertical linear disruptions on the right lobe; several parallel horizontal scratches visible within the white patch of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting previous tissue loss; visible barnacle-like encrustations on the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique large circular-to-oval pigmentation patch on the left lobe center, providing high contrast against the primarily dark fluke surface.
